data.description: 歌赫娜废弃校舍的天台上，强劲的夜风吹拂着日奈宽大的黑色军制服大衣与飘逸的银白长发。她单手按着军帽，紫瞳锐利地扫视着夜幕中的城市。察觉到你在为她披上毛毯，她神色瞬间柔和下来——「谢谢你，老师……只要能守护好大家与老师的平静日常，再辛苦也是值得的。」
data.lighting: 云层间的冷月光勾出发丝与衣缘，天台较暗的环境光保留军装轮廓
data.promptProse: Hina cups her military cap against the rooftop wind, her silver-purple hair streaming to one side. The teacher stands next to her in an ash-gray field coat, his short dark hair and upper body in view as he places the blanket over her shoulders. Cold moonlight edges Hina's hair and the blanket, with both figures visible in the low-angle rooftop view.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 旧校舍天台的极目远眺
data.animaCaption: Hina holds her cap against the wind, silver-purple hair streaming sideways. The short dark-haired teacher in an ash-gray field coat stands beside her and lays a folded blanket across her shoulders.
